description: This file defines the IUserSettings interface within the WPEFramework project's Exchange namespace. It provides a way to manage and notify changes for user settings related to audiovisual preferences, captions, languages, and privacy options. It declares an interface with methods for setting, getting, registering notifications, and a nested notification interface for event callbacks.

classes.name: IUserSettings
classes.description: An interface for managing user settings like audio descriptions, languages, captions, closed caption services, and privacy modes, with registration for notification callbacks.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: A nested interface within IUserSettings that provides callback methods triggered when user setting preferences change.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for user setting changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: SetAudioDescription
methods.description: Enables or disables audio description tracks.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of audio description setting.

methods.name: SetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Sets the list of preferred audio languages.

methods.name: GetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Gets the current list of preferred audio languages.

methods.name: GetPresentationLanguage
methods.description: Gets the current presentation language setting.

methods.name: SetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Sets the preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Gets the current preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: SetPrivacyMode
methods.description: Sets the privacy mode (e.g., SHARE or DO_NOT_SHARE).

methods.name: GetPrivacyMode
methods.description: Gets the current privacy mode setting.

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^  struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
